test_title: PYST 58: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  on 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

An __awkward neither grammatically__ accurate sentence is the result of centre implanting.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the phrase "neither grammatically accurate" is incorrect.
 
• The correct phrase should be **"awkward but grammatically accurate"**.
 
• Therefore, the correct substitution is "awkward but grammatically accurate".
 
 
• **Example **: It was an** awkward** ascent, **but** we reached the top eventually.
 
 

Hence, the correct statement is** '*****An awkward but grammatically__ accurate sentence is the result of centre implanting*****.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• When constructing sentences, always ensure that phrases are both** logically and grammatically** consistent.
 
• Using conjunctions like **"but" **can help in creating contrast while maintaining grammatical accuracy.
